title: Persona module manifest
description: module.json of a Persona Core feature module (docs/architecture/core-and-modules.md, #13430 section 4). One manifest concept with the same field names on every platform: the server reads it as modapi.Info (server/internal/modapi), the clients as their own typed registration. Each list names what the module adds through one kind of slot; a module adds nothing it does not declare. A host that does not serve a slot yet does not load a module that fills it. Built-in modules and extensions share this shape (origin).

ID.description: A module id: lower case, words joined by -.

Name.description: A name a slot knows (a key, a route pattern, a tool, a template, a kind).

$schema.description: The path of this schema, for editors.

api.description: The version of the module contract the module was written for; a host serving another version does not load it.

origin.description: builtin: compiled into the app or the manager; extension: installed at run time.

title.description: A short English label for logs and settings; clients localize by id.

needs.description: Module ids that must be loaded for this one to load.

wants.description: Module ids this one uses when they are loaded.

feature.description: The wire feature flag announced while the module is loaded: module.<id>. The reserved modules marker lets clients distinguish an older hub from one with every module off.

schedules.description: Scheduler contributions (#13402); facts: the facts a scheduled routine with facts on opens with.

db_migrations.description: Database migration file names the module owns.

node_programs.description: Programs a computer's node runs for the module.
